newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 summer grain output seen matching 1996.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 summer grain output seen matching 1996.

text.p: China's 1997 summer grain harvest will be no lower than the 1996 level because of favourable weather conditions, Shanghai's Business News said on Friday.
Area planted for summer grain will reach 31.88 million hectares (78.777 million acres), up 333,500 hectares (824,095 acres) on the same 1996 period, the newspaper said.
A total of 26.013 million hectares (64.28 million acres) has been planted with winter wheat, up 400,200 hectares (989,000 acres) on 1996, it said.
Area planted with rapeseed in autumn and winter 1996 fell 133,400 hectares (330,000 acres) to 6.34 million hectares (15.66 million acres), it said.
Rapeseed is growing well in all places except Hubei province, it said, but gave no further details.
